title: Money sent home by migrant workers vs global foreign aid (billion $)
geography: Global (remittances to low/middle-income countries) vs worldwide ODA
notes: World Bank remittance flows to low- and middle-income countries and OECD DAC official development assistance (ODA) totals. Remittances: ~55B (1995), ~85B (2000), ~192B (2005), ~325B (2010), ~441B (2015), ~540B (2020), ~685B (2024, estimate). ODA: ~59B (1995), ~49B (2000), ~108B (2005), ~129B (2010), ~131B (2015), ~161B (2020), ~212B (2024). World Bank notes remittances to LMICs have exceeded ODA in every estimate since the mid-1990s. Figures approximate/rounded.
